sources.snippet: We release Qwen2.5-Omni, the new flagship end-to-end multimodal model in the Qwen series. Designed for comprehensive multimodal perception, it seamlessly processes diverse inputs including text, images, audio, and video, while delivering real-time streaming responses through both text generation and natural speech synthesis.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Omni-7B - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: The new multi-modal understanding and generation model trained based on Qwen2.5. It supports text, image, speech, video, and mixed input understanding and can simultaneously generate streams of text and speech, significantly improves the speed of multi-modal content understanding. It provides four natural tones.
